versions.content: If a CanIf Controller mode state machine is in state CAN_CS_- STARTED when the function CanIf_TTSevereError(ControllerId, CanIf_- TTSevereError) is called with parameter ControllerId referencing that CanIf Controller mode state machine, then CanIf shall call Can_SetControllerMode (Controller, CAN_CS_STOPPED) and CanIf shall call CanSM_ControllerBu- sOff(ControllerId) of CanSM .
